info.title: BioAvanceD API
info.description: BioAvanceD backend API (RNF006 C2, #1325). This spec covers only the mounts listed in x-covered-mounts; the rest of the API is not yet documented here. Every response body is JSON with a boolean success; a failure carries error and, often, message. Outside the test environment every route sits behind the global rate limiter and /api/auth also behind the auth limiter, and a request over either limit answers 429.

The 503 comes from authenticate and from the handler. The organization is resolved before anything is staged and is stamped on the batch. The organization is resolved from the caller: a caller of one organization uses it, a caller of several must name organizationId (400 otherwise), a global caller may name any registered one (404 when it is unknown) or none. post.description: Gates: authenticate (router.use), requirePermission('manageStorageAllocation'), requireOrganizationScope. RF016 AC6. The value is normalized (an AIM symbology prefix and surrounding whitespace dropped) and resolved through its active label to a container and through the container's open load to a specimen, or, while the migration window is open, as a legacy sample barcode. Only a resolved scan is recorded as a ScanEvent. An unresolved one answers 200 with resolved false and a reason: UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER, NOT_A_CONTAINER or EMPTY_CONTAINER. The 400 is a missing rawValue, symbology or deviceId (INVALID_INPUT); the 422 a scanner that is not a registered, homologated, unretired device (DEVICE_UNUSABLE, RF017 AC8); the 403 a specimen of another organization, with no ScanEvent written (SPECIMEN_OUT_OF_SCOPE). Any other error answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. The 503 comes from authenticate.

scanEvent.description: The recorded ScanEvent, when resolved is true.

500.description: Internal error; the error is INTERNAL_ERROR when the handler raised it.

post.summary: Create a temperature policy
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('manageTemperaturePolicy'); no organization scope. The 422 (error "Dados inválidos", details a list of reasons) is a name that is not a non-blank string, a minTemp or maxTemp that is not a number, minTemp not below maxTemp, or a truthy temperatureUnit other than °C. An empty temperatureUnit is stored as °C. The handler's catch answers 400 (not 500) when the insert fails, and sends no 500 of its own; the 500 comes from the gates. The 503 comes from authenticate and from the handler (no database).

temperatureUnit.description: Celsius only (#1198); an empty value is stored as °C.

minimumDuration.description: Minutes; omitted is stored as null (#1195).

400.description: The insert failed.

put.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('manageTemperaturePolicy'); no organization scope. The body has no required field: only the fields sent are written (name, minTemp, maxTemp, hysteresis, minimumDuration, temperatureUnit, and effectivePeriod.start and .end each when sent). Only the unit is checked (422, same shape as POST); types and minTemp < maxTemp are not. The id is looked up by _id only: an id that is not a 24-hex ObjectId throws and the catch answers 400, so a legacy numeric policyId cannot be updated; no match answers 404. The success carries a message and no data. The handler sends no 500; the 500 comes from the gates. The 503 comes from authenticate and from the handler (no database).

post.summary: Dispatch a shipment
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(3, 4) (Coordenador or Administrador), requireOrganizationScope. The body is validated first, so every missing or malformed field answers 422 VALIDATION_ERROR (details lists each reason) before any 403 or 404. Exactly one of dispositionActionId and accessRequestId must be a non-blank string: both or neither answer 422, and an empty string counts as not sent (a whitespace-only dispositionActionId passes this check but is still looked up, and answers 404 AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND). Then: 403 OUT_OF_SCOPE when the sender organization is outside the caller's scope; 422 ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND when the sender or recipient is unknown; 404 AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND; 422 AUTHORIZATION_NOT_TRANSFER (the disposition action is not a transfer of specimens); 409 AUTHORIZATION_NOT_EXECUTED (transfer not executed) or AUTHORIZATION_NOT_RELEASED (distribution not released); 422 SPECIMEN_NOT_FOUND or SPECIMEN_NOT_AUTHORIZED. The dispatch is audited. The 503 comes from authenticate and from the handler. The 500 is also a failure of the dispatch. The route has no 400 (#660).

specimenIds.description: Non-blank ids; each matched by the specimen's canonical id or its _id.

senderOrganization.description: Must be in the caller's organization scope.

dispositionActionId.description: An executed transfer disposition action. Send this or accessRequestId, not both.

accessRequestId.description: An access request whose distribution was released. Send this or dispositionActionId, not both.

404.description: AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND: the disposition action or access request does not exist.

409.description: AUTHORIZATION_NOT_EXECUTED (the transfer is not executed) or AUTHORIZATION_NOT_RELEASED (the distribution is not released).

422.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (details lists each reason), ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND, AUTHORIZATION_NOT_TRANSFER, SPECIMEN_NOT_FOUND or SPECIMEN_NOT_AUTHORIZED; error carries the code and details only comes with VALIDATION_ERROR.

get.summary: List the shipments of the caller's organizations
get.description: Gates: authenticate, requireOrganizationScope. Returns the shipments whose sender or recipient organization is in the caller's scope (all for a global caller), newest dispatchDateTime first. The 503 comes from authenticate and from the handler. The 500 is also a failure of the read. The route has no 400.

Gates: authenticate, requireOrganizationScope. The 404 is an unknown shipment (SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND). The 403 is a shipment whose sender and recipient are both outside the caller's scope (OUT_OF_SCOPE), or a caller with no organization. The 503 comes from authenticate and from the handler. The route has no 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The shipmentId (a UUID).

post.summary: Record the receipt of a shipment
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(3, 4) (Coordenador or Administrador), requireOrganizationScope. The checks run in this order: 404 SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND; 403 OUT_OF_SCOPE (the recipient organization is outside the caller's scope); 409 ALREADY_RECEIVED; then the body, 422 VALIDATION_ERROR (details lists each reason) for a missing or invalid receiptDateTime, one before the dispatch, or a conditionOnReceipt that is not an object or has a key other than integrity, temperature, packaging and discrepancies; then 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE when the shipment changed meanwhile. So a missing receiptDateTime is answered 422 only after the 404, 403 and 409 checks. The receipt is audited. The 503 comes from authenticate and from the handler. The route has no 400.

parameters.description: The shipmentId (a UUID).

receiptDateTime.description: ISO 8601, not before the shipment's dispatchDateTime.

conditionOnReceipt.description: Integrity, temperature, packaging and discrepancies on arrival (ELM-0407); no other key.
